Text.Text: Their authority is revoked and your examination is complete. Keep your resolve; don't mistake it for certainty. You've finished my Eclipse of Resolve trials. I have no further work for you here.
Admission to this examination requires rank 50 in Force. Return when you meet that standard. Resolve must survive more than a conversation.

Former candidates are teaching a corrupted doctrine in the crypt depths. Confiscate their tablet so I can examine what they've changed. Defeat six Eclipse of Resolve Adepts in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Eclipse of Resolve Crypt Trial Tablet; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wastelands Tunnels. I'll give you the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Eclipse of Resolve.

Here's the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths Key. Use 'Sith Crypt Depths' in Korriban, Sith Crypt. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Eclipse of Resolve Adepts, then return with the Eclipse of Resolve Crypt Trial Tablet.

In my words, since yours would mangle it: resolve that admits no fear-light whatsoever. Not courage. Courage coexists with fear. An eclipse. The will passes in front of everything else and the mind goes usefully dark. Done correctly, hesitation becomes physically impossible. Done incorrectly, you get what festers below us: candidates who eclipsed their judgment instead. The examination exists to tell the difference.

Former candidates who failed my examination and decided to teach themselves. They continued their training in the Sith Crypt Depths without supervision. Use 'Sith Crypt Depths' in the Sith Crypt once you've accepted my key. Their confidence has grown faster than their understanding.

Prepare for candidates with nothing left to lose academically. A failed adept fights worse than a passed one, but harder; desperation is poor technique with excellent attendance. Six of them, in crypts that amplify fear, which is the one resource you must not bring. If you feel the dark pressing in, treat it as part of the test. It is. Everything is.
Defeat six Eclipse of Resolve Adepts in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Eclipse of Resolve Crypt Trial Tablet; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wastelands Tunnels.
You've defeated six Eclipse of Resolve Adepts. Let me see the Eclipse of Resolve Crypt Trial Tablet.
The tablet gives us a clear account of their teaching. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists sustain their doctrine with a focus shard. Recover it for the next examination. Defeat five Eclipse of Resolve Specialists in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Eclipse of Resolve Ritual Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wastelands Tunnels.
Your key still grants access to Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Defeat five Eclipse of Resolve Specialists to secure the Eclipse of Resolve Ritual Focus Shard, then return to me.

It proves my thesis, which is why I want it preserved. True eclipse is the will outshining fear. The fear remains present, simply irrelevant. The specialists instead decant their fear into a stone and congratulate themselves on feeling nothing. Feeling nothing is not passing. That shard is five students' worth of discarded fear in one object. As doctrinal evidence, it is a signed confession.

Use 'Sith Crypt Depths' in Korriban, Sith Crypt. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat five Eclipse of Resolve Specialists in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Eclipse of Resolve Ritual Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wastelands Tunnels.

Fearlessly, in the defective sense. They cannot retreat. Retreat requires the fear they threw away. So they will press you in waves, without self-preservation, and undisciplined aggression from five directions defeats most candidates through arithmetic alone. Keep your footing, spend their recklessness against them, and remember which one of you can still choose to be careful. That choice is the entire examination.
Defeat five Eclipse of Resolve Specialists in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Eclipse of Resolve Ritual Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wastelands Tunnels.
You've defeated five Eclipse of Resolve Specialists. Let me see the Eclipse of Resolve Ritual Focus Shard.
The focus is out of their hands. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden carries a sigil he was never fit to hold. Take it back and end his claim. Defeat the Eclipse of Resolve Warden in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Eclipse of Resolve Splintered Tomb Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wastelands Tunnels. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Eclipse of Resolve Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Eclipse of Resolve Splintered Tomb Sigil.

Precision. His eclipse was flawless in form. Will out front, fear irrelevant, hesitation extinct. I nearly passed him. Then I saw what his will had fixed upon: the doorway itself. Holding it. Forever. Against everything, for nothing. A perfect instrument aimed at a meaningless target. I failed him, and he appealed the verdict by moving into the breach. He has been appealing it ever since.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Eclipse of Resolve Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

The tomb seal he swore his eclipse to. It splintered when the deep doors were forced, and he keeps the pieces as proof that his vigil continues. Which is to say, as proof that he cannot admit an ended thing has ended. Doctrinally, it is the most instructive object in the crypt: resolve outliving its reason. Bring it to me and I will show the next generation what that costs.

Defeat the Eclipse of Resolve Warden in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Eclipse of Resolve Splintered Tomb Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wastelands Tunnels. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Eclipse of Resolve Warden. Let me see the Eclipse of Resolve Splintered Tomb Sigil.
The sigil no longer backs the warden's claim. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The four keepers are still passing that doctrine on. Recover their rite token and revoke their authority. Defeat four members of the Eclipse of Resolve Inner Circle in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Eclipse of Resolve Keeper's Rite Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wastelands Tunnels.
Your key still grants access to Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Defeat four members of the Eclipse of Resolve Inner Circle to secure the Eclipse of Resolve Keeper's Rite Token, then return to me.

A forgery with excellent penmanship. They kept my structure, the trials, the proofs, the ordinations, and inverted the content. Where I teach the will to outshine fear, they teach the student to burn out the part that fears. Their graduates are the adepts and specialists you removed. Fearless the way the dead are fearless. Four authors, one plagiarized doctrine, an entire cell of ruined students. That is their bibliography.

It is my token. I struck it years ago to mark candidates approved to teach, and the circle's founders stole it when they fled below. Every ordination since has been a forgery bearing my seal. You see now why this examination is not optional, for either of us. Recover it, and the last thing legitimizing their curriculum returns to the only hand holding actual authority.

One recommendation, not a condition. You have earned the distinction. They defend the token as a single body, four wills braided into one doctrine, and braided wills unravel from the ends. Whichever of them breaks formation first is the thread to cut. If you bring your two from the breach, so much the better. I no longer grade whether you need others. I grade the others fortunate.

Defeat four members of the Eclipse of Resolve Inner Circle in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Eclipse of Resolve Keeper's Rite Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wastelands Tunnels.
You've defeated four members of the Eclipse of Resolve Inner Circle. Let me see the Eclipse of Resolve Keeper's Rite Token.
Their authority to teach is ended. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the final examination. Defeat him in the ritual chamber, then bring me your report. Defeat the Eclipse of Resolve Master in Korriban, Final Ritual Chamber. Report back to me here in Korriban, Wastelands Tunnels; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Final Ritual Chamber, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Eclipse of Resolve Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Nothing went wrong with the eclipse. That is the horror of it, and the final lesson. The doctrine worked. His will outshone fear so completely that nothing remained to tell him when to stop willing. Resolve requires an object, something to be resolved toward, and he burned through every object he had. Now the eclipse sustains itself. What eclipsed his resolve was his resolve. Write that down somewhere you will reread it.

Then the record shows one pass, and that pass holds the bottom of a crypt until Korriban wears away. I do not examine for sentiment, but understand what you carry down that stair: every verdict I have ever issued rests on whether this doctrine can produce something other than him. You are the retrial of my life's work. I suggest you find that motivating rather than heavy. That is also part of the test.

I recommend two companions against the Eclipse of Resolve Master. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

Defeat the Eclipse of Resolve Master in Korriban, Final Ritual Chamber. Report back to me here in Korriban, Wastelands Tunnels; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Eclipse of Resolve Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
Their authority is revoked and your examination is complete. Keep your resolve; don't mistake it for certainty. You've earned the right to train Eclipse of Resolve. Your final payment is ready.
Restate the assignment.
I'll defeat six Eclipse of Resolve Adepts.
What is the Eclipse of Resolve, in your own words?
Who are these failed candidates?
What should I prepare for down there?
I'll submit when I'm ready. Not before.
Here's the Eclipse of Resolve Crypt Trial Tablet.
Back to the paper.
I'll defeat five Eclipse of Resolve Specialists.
What does the shard prove?
Where will I find them?
How do they fight?
I'll sit this paper after I've reviewed my notes.
Here's the Eclipse of Resolve Ritual Focus Shard.
Back to the practical.
I'll defeat the Eclipse of Resolve Warden.
What made him your most promising failure?
Would you recommend bringing help?
What is the sigil evidence of?
I'll assemble my examinees first.
Here's the Eclipse of Resolve Splintered Tomb Sigil.
Back to the retraction.
I'll defeat four members of the Eclipse of Resolve Inner Circle.
What did the inner circle actually teach?
And the token ordains them?
Four at once. Any examination conditions?
The retraction can wait a day.
Here's the Eclipse of Resolve Keeper's Rite Token.
Back to the examination.
I'll face the Eclipse of Resolve Master and report back.
What went wrong, if his eclipse was flawless?
What happens to your record if we fail?
How do we fight a flawless eclipse?
My examinees need preparation. The trial waits.
The Eclipse of Resolve Master is defeated. Here's my report.
